title: zod validation errors serialize function call arguments

linked_prs.title: fix(ai): use parsed tool input if possible when validation fails
linked_prs.body:
## Background

Tool call parts with string input (in case of validation errors) were rejected by the Google GenAI API (see #7869 )

## Summary

When possible, use the parsed json input object even when the tool call validation fails.

## Manual Verification

Tested example from #7869

## Related Issues

Fixes #7869

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.

Explanation:  
This issue involves tool invocation with Zod schema validation, incorrect serialization of functionCall arguments, and integration with the Google Generative AI provider. It directly concerns tool implementation and LLM provider compatibility—both are agent-specific components per the taxonomy.
